title: 2004 AMC 10B Problem 3
statement: At each basketball practice last week, Jenny made twice as many free throws as she made at the previous practice. At her fifth practice she made \(48\) free throws. How many free throws did she make at the first practice?

solutions.text:
Working backward from the fifth practice, the counts are \(48, 24, 12, 6,\) and \(3\) at the fourth, third, second, and first practices.

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Each practice count is twice the previous one, so work backward by halving
Halve \(48\) repeatedly to reach the first practice
